breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the inconsistency. The original prompt contained a contradictory preamble about how to interpret Nx and dx. The ground truth fixed this by removing the contradictory sentence. The agent, by summarizing the prompt into a clear specification, omitted the entire confusing preamble and only included the final, correct instructions for the numerical method, thereby creating an unambiguous set of requirements.
